J&J's gross profit rose about 4.2% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025. I calculated it as sales to customers minus cost of products sold, using the figures in J&J's Q4 and full-year 2025 earnings release.

| | Fiscal 2025 | Fiscal 2024 |
|---|---|---|
| Sales to customers | $94,193M | $88,821M |
| Cost of products sold | $30,256M | $27,471M |
| Gross profit | $63,937M | $61,350M |

The change is (63,937 − 61,350) / 61,350, which is about +4.22%.
